text: He remembers the maiden, as if a second creation of the God of Love, whose saffron-threaded girdle repeatedly slipped from her hips and hung down, placed there with knowing grace. Her fragrant breath intensified the longing; her lips, like Bimba fruits, moved softly. Every moment, with a gaze trembling in agitation, she sought to avert his sight with her playful, lotus-like gestures. Beholding her, whose every limb was flawless and who possessed a modesty that would surpass even that of Rati, the flower-bow of Kamadeva hopes once more for the success of its mission, even against the trident-bearer who has conquered his senses.
